pages.text: $(li)$(l:magic/irons2#ars_bond_scroll_forge)Scroll Forge$(/l): ink, paper and a focus make new scrolls. Better ink, rarer spells. Its heart is a Source Gem Block.$(li)$(l:magic/irons2#ars_bond_scroll_forge)Alchemist Cauldron$(/l): boils scrolls back down to ink, and brews.
$(li)$(l:magic/irons2#arcane_anvil)Arcane Anvil$(/l): merges scrolls, imbues weapons, and sets an $(l:magic/irons2#arcane_anvil)Upgrade Orb$(/l) into armor.
